# FowlerNordheimAnnealer

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A hardware annealing mechanism that uses Fowler-Nordheim quantum tunneling effects to modulate energy barriers in a neuromorphic Ising machine, providing a novel physical annealing pathway. Offers a potentially faster and more energy-efficient annealing process compared to thermal or optical methods, crucial for scalable in-network optimization hardware.
